coverage.note: Representative schema-proving set; loader accepts further entries without code change.

review_form.name: Per-entry quality gate + originality gate
review_form.scoring: each of the entry's own gate dimensions >= 8, NO averaging (guide universal quality rule); PLUS the image-guide per-artifact rule at stage level (FIX-PLAN B5)

questions: Does this resemble a specific known artwork?
Is the composition too close to a famous image?
Am I using a signature character/motif as a shortcut?
For contemporary-reference systems, is this an independent work based on broad formal principles?
originality_gate.form: reviewer attestation; the non-copying core is not artifact-verifiable (FIX-PLAN B6)
originality_gate.source: Final Agent Execution Protocol, Step 6 - Run the originality gate, lines 2796-2801; the underlying rule is section 0 Universal originality rule, lines 43-45: 'Never reproduce a known artwork, exact pose, exact layout, signature character, famous prop arrangement, or recognizable source image.' Note: the four questions themselves are in the Final Protocol, not in section 0; section 0 contains the rule statement only.

review_form.exactly_one_system_rule: false unless the user explicitly requested a hybrid; a compliant prompt carries the selected system's branded name (assembly slot 1)

mandatory_traits.text: Skin rendered in warm neutral grayscale, broad tonal range but low chroma; skin entirely in nuanced warm grayscale with careful facial modeling
Background is a simple, flat or nearly flat chromatic color field selected to create clean separation from clothing and flesh and to complement rather than match the garment
Clothing is saturated, patterned, graphic, contemporary and compositionally important; vivid or patterned garment is the primary chromatic structure
Pose is frontal or nearly frontal, quiet, balanced, dignified and contained rather than theatrical; restrained pose, no fashion-model exaggeration
Gaze is direct or psychologically self-contained; sitter looks at viewer or slightly away with self-contained expression
Light is soft studio illumination with modest modeling; soft, even light, no hard cinema shadow unless the concept needs it
Edges show clear figure-ground separation
Props are few; any prop must add identity or narrative
Space is shallow; environment is intentionally withheld so viewer attends to sitter and clothing

Image feels painted and intentional, not like a photo with a grayscale filter applied to skin; hair, eyes, lips and hands integrated into the grayscale logic unless a deliberate small accent is conceptually necessary

avoid.text: gray skin that reads as metallic, dead, or desaturated by accident
copying a known garment, color pairing, or pose
over-smoothed skin or excessive glamour retouching

uncheckable_by_design.reason: Mood is a reception/judgment property of the produced image; its words can be stated in a prompt but compliance can only be judged by looking, per diagnostic notes classification (b).

mandatory_traits.text: Shape is angular, simplified and planar; bodies and architecture share a geometric vocabulary; scene reduced to large matte geometric shapes
Space is flattened and compressed; perspective can tilt or stack for narrative clarity
Palette uses recurring colors (black, brown, ochre, mustard, red, green, blue/turquoise, white, gray), matte rather than glossy, limited to 5 to 7 governing colors for the entire image
Line uses dark contours and strong edges to organize and separate forms
Figures have simplified faces and limbs, clear actions, communal rather than portrait-focused; gesture and occupation remain unmistakable
Narrative is a single historical or social action (labor, movement, migration, family, conflict, community, history or aspiration); one action only, unrelated subplots eliminated
Rhythm created by repeating shape and color across the scene like musical phrases; repeated shape creates rhythm
Architecture (stairs, rails, doors, windows, tables, machinery, roads) creates diagonals and directional flow that move the viewer through the scene
Light is represented through color/value blocks rather than realistic atmospheric modeling
Series logic: even a single image feels like one panel from a larger story; if a sequence, the full palette is established first and distributed across all panels

avoid.text: cartoon outlines with no geometric structure
copying an existing Migration Series panel
random bright colors that break palette continuity
atmospheric blur or glossy digital rendering

mandatory_traits.text: Brushwork is short broken strokes, dabs, commas, horizontal flicks on water, directional marks in vegetation; forms constructed from broken strokes rather than smooth gradients
Color mixing favors optical adjacency of relatively pure colors over smooth digital blending
Light is the dominant subject; local object color shifts dramatically with hour and weather; a precise lighting condition (exact hour/weather) is defined before painting
Shadows are colored, never automatically gray/black; color exists inside the shadows
Edges are hard near selected focal areas and soft or dissolved in distance/atmosphere; distant contours softened through small value differences instead of blur filters
Palette varies with condition (cool violet/blue fog, warm peach/gold sunset, green/blue daylight, snow with colored shadows)
Water reflection is constructed from horizontal strokes that echo but distort vertical forms; water painted with mostly horizontal strokes broken by ripples and light, echoing major colors vertically
Space is believable but atmospheric; detail decreases with distance
Composition uses an ordinary motif observed intensely; asymmetry and cropping can feel immediate
Series logic: repeat one original motif across multiple conditions to study transformation; for a series, lock viewpoint and composition and change only time, weather, season and resulting palette

avoid.text: over-saturated rainbow color unrelated to observed light
impasto so thick that color relationships disappear

mandatory_traits.text: Stencil has hard graphic edges, simplified shapes, strong silhouette, limited tonal passes, selective interior detail, subtle overspray and plausible stencil bridges; main stencil graphic and readable, action reads from silhouette
Palette is 75 to 95 percent neutral (black, charcoal, dirty white, masonry gray, aged cream, brick); one strong accent color can carry symbolic importance and marks the conceptually important object
Surface is real brick, concrete, peeling plaster, rust, grime, cracks, stains, patched masonry or old paint; intervention integrated into a real weathered architectural surface with wall visible
Composition has substantial negative space; artwork occupies only 15 to 40 percent of the architectural field, most of the frame is ordinary environment
Gesture/action must read from silhouette (walking, reaching, pulling, releasing, hiding, carrying, resisting, observing)

Environment participates: pipes, cracks, bars, doors, conduits, signs, curbs, windows, fences, shadows, fire escapes or utility boxes become metaphoric components; one environmental feature becomes a functional part of the visual metaphor
Irony uses one dominant contradiction rather than multiple unrelated messages; one primary contrast pairing chosen, do not combine more than two major oppositions
Texture uses restrained overspray and broken edges; avoid expressive paint explosions
Text is optional, ideally 1 to 7 words; image must still work without it
Physical plausibility: viewer should believe the intervention could exist on the wall; materially plausible with restrained spray irregularity
Concept is built before rendering from one main subject, one meaningful symbol, one dominant contradiction and one environmental feature (SUBJECT + SYMBOL + CONTRADICTION + ENVIRONMENT = CONCEPT)
Two-stage reading: first read literal scene registers immediately, second read a secondary relationship changes the meaning

avoid.text: merely a stencil portrait (failure condition: reject and redesign)
environment is only background / wall treated as blank canvas (failure condition)
symbol requires a paragraph of explanation / symbol too obscure (failure condition)
color is ornamental rather than meaningful (failure condition)
image resembles a famous existing street artwork (failure condition)
recreating a known artwork, signature character, phrase, composition, or motif (execution mode)

uncheckable_by_design.text: Second read / delayed second meaning: what the viewer realizes 1-3 seconds later
uncheckable_by_design.reason: A reception property; presence of the field is checkable in the concept spec, but whether a viewer actually gets a second read can only be judged by looking, per diagnostic notes classification (b). The field itself is recorded in pre_render_concept_fields.

mandatory_traits.text: Color is flat brilliant acrylic-like color in painted mode, with scene palette exemplified by cyan/blue water, warm skin, cream concrete, green lawn, bright clothing, clear sky; select palette from the actual scene
Surface is smooth, controlled, minimal brush texture in painted mode; environment built from clean flat acrylic-like color masses
Geometry uses strong horizontals/verticals countered by fluid water marks or organic figures, with crisp architectural edges and clean rectilinear architecture
Perspective is clean but slightly stylized in painted mode and deliberately plural in joiner mode
Light is strong daylight with clear shadows; atmosphere bright rather than dramatic; hard California-like light in Mode A

Water is rendered through repeated line motifs, broken reflections and flat color shifts; in generation, repeated graphic ripples, reflected color shards and selective white marks rather than photoreal simulation
Figure is ordinary leisure or portrait presence, integrated casually rather than heroically, behavior casual and psychologically understated; avoid melodrama
Crop is a modern photographic crop; edges can feel casual yet calculated
Time: in joiner mode, do not force all tiles to represent the identical instant; time advances across tiles and small time differences are permitted

Joiner mode (Mode B): divide the scene into 15 to 60 overlapping original photo rectangles, shift viewpoint gradually, preserve tile edges and overlaps, repeated body parts or moving objects can mark time

avoid.text: single-perspective photo cut into arbitrary squares
fisheye distortion pretending to be multiple viewpoint
hyperreal water simulation in painted mode

mandatory_traits.text: Light is one dominant directional source with rapid transition from bright flesh/highlight into deep surrounding dark; one strong off-axis light source illuminates only the faces, hands and objects needed for the decisive moment

Darkness is large masses of low-information shadow with subtle reflected values preserved rather than pure digital black everywhere; darkness withholds information, shadows are not filled with decorative detail
Figures are ordinary human bodies with physical imperfections, believable age, weight, hands, feet, dirt and fabric; realistic flesh and worn fabric
Composition is tight crop, shallow space, diagonals, figures entering from the frame edge; bodies overlap and enter from frame edges, one strong diagonal through gesture or gaze
Gesture carries the narrative: hands, pointing, reaching, grasping, recoiling, leaning, turning
Moment is a revelatory decisive moment: recognition, accusation, conversion, discovery, risk, invitation, violence or sudden realization; light reveals a specific fact
Objects are tangible and rendered with physical specificity (fruit, glass, metal, cards, bread, cloth, tools, instruments, tableware)
Palette is black/brown ground, warm flesh, white linen, deep red, ochre, muted green, selective blue
Foreshortening: arms, hands, legs or objects may project toward the viewer and must render scale and perspective convincingly
Emotion is immediate and bodily rather than remote idealization

avoid.text: copying The Calling of Saint Matthew, Judith, Supper at Emmaus, or other known arrangements
fog or volumetric beams that make the light theatrical in a modern cinematic way
empty black backgrounds with no spatial logic

uncheckable_by_design.text: Emotion immediate and bodily rather than remote idealization, as a produced-image quality
uncheckable_by_design.reason: Trait words are stated above with tokens for prompt-level checking; whether the produced image achieves bodily immediacy is judgment-only on the image, per diagnostic notes classification (b).

mandatory_traits.text: Format is wide panorama or three-part progression with high horizon; foreground/middle/distance packed with episodes; world divided conceptually into three zones or stages
Scale uses many small figures plus several larger anchor forms; 2 to 3 large anchor forms established first to help viewer navigate density
Creature design: hybrids built from 2 to 4 recognizable source categories (for example bird + vessel + plant, human + architecture + fish), repeated so the world feels related rather than random
Architecture is invented organic towers, shells, ruins, transparent structures, machines, caves, vessels

Palette uses clear blues, greens, warm earth, pale flesh, red accents, dark catastrophic zones where relevant; palette and material condition shift gradually if the image moves from benign to catastrophic
Narrative clusters: each local group performs an understandable mini-action; 8 to 15 mini-scenes support the governing theme

Symbol uses object consequences, bodily metaphors, appetite, vanity, labor, pleasure, fear, punishment or salvation, chosen appropriate to the prompt, under one governing moral, philosophical or psychological theme
Perspective is stacked but legible landscape recession with visual paths between clusters through rivers, roads, architectural arcs, color bands or repeated motifs
Detail is extremely high and meticulous; tiny actions reward zooming, with clear daylight or zone-specific light

avoid.text: copying creatures from The Garden of Earthly Delights
dark fantasy concept-art lighting across the whole scene
one giant creature dominating every narrative
symbol overload with no governing theme

uncheckable_by_design.text: Tone: wonder, absurdity, menace, satire and morality can coexist
uncheckable_by_design.reason: Tonal coexistence is a judgment property of the produced image; no token in a prompt certifies it, per diagnostic notes classification (b). Extracted as a Visual DNA bullet in the guide (lines 2393-2442) but not forced into mandatory_traits with tokens.

mandatory_traits.text: Format is vertical or near-vertical large field, usually with major hovering zones (see zone_count_conflict; checkable band is the overlap 2 to 3)
Shape is approximate rectangle, softened, rounded, irregular, feathered, sometimes cut off by canvas edge; avoid hard graphic corners

Ground is an active color, not a neutral backing; colored ground laid down in several thin uneven washes so subtle value variation remains, ground establishes the emotional state before fields are added
Layer uses many thin stains/glazes with undercolor visible through top color; each field contains at least one underlayer whose color appears through thin upper paint, especially near the edge

Edge is a transitional zone where colors mingle, vibrate or expose prior layers; boundaries softened with feathery transitions while preserving an irregular shape, soft and alive rather than blurred uniformly
Surface is matte to softly luminous; avoid glossy graphic finish; surface quiet enough that small hue changes matter
Color relationships are emotionally coherent; relationships matter more than fashionable color matching; palette serves the chosen emotional objective
Scale is immersive; color areas feel bodily in proportion rather than logo-like or poster-like
Space is ambiguous hovering; forms can advance/recede without perspective

An emotional objective is chosen first (one or two dominant states such as tragedy, ecstasy, dread, warmth, silence, radiance, gravity) and the palette serves it; one field feels heavier and one more luminous

avoid.text: treating the system as simple color matching

visual_dna.text: Format: vertical or near-vertical large field; usually 2-4 major hovering zones.

generation_instructions.text: Add two or three large hovering color fields.

zone_count_conflict.research_synthesis_note: Research synthesis in the same entry also states 'two or three large, soft-edged zones of color stacked vertically against a colored ground' (lines 2603-2652), agreeing with the generation text, not the Visual DNA count.
zone_count_conflict.checkable_band_note: Overlap of [2,4] and [2,3] is [2,3]; a validator must use 2 to 3 as the checkable band and must not fail a 3-zone image or certify a 4-zone image on either passage alone (FIX-PLAN conflict N5).

uncheckable_by_design.text: Mood / emotional presence: fields behaving like presences rather than graphic rectangles, rewarding sustained viewing
uncheckable_by_design.reason: Emotional coherence and presence are judgment properties of the produced image; the recorded emotional choice is checkable in the spec, achievement is not, per diagnostic notes classification (b).
